name: posthog-squad
description: Single-agent PostHog squad: daily digest (DAU/WAU/MAU, north-star, engaged + dying), activation-funnel debugger, release-impact tracker, mid-day anomaly alerts, auto-maintained PostHog cohorts.
author: pancake-official

required_vault_secrets.label: PostHog personal API key (read-only — Settings → Personal API keys → read access on Query, Insight, Event definition, Action, Person, Cohort)
PostHog project ID (numeric — Settings → Project → 'Project ID')
PostHog host — 'https://us.posthog.com', 'https://eu.posthog.com', or a self-hosted base URL
Comma-separated PostHog event names that count as 'real product use' (e.g. message_sent,workspace_created) — agreed during onboarding
The single PostHog event that means a new signup is now 'activated' (e.g. first_message_sent). One event name, no commas.
The single PostHog event that fires when a new user signs up (e.g. user_signed_up). Used by the activation funnel debugger. Defaults to user_signed_up if blank.
GitHub repo slug owner/name to watch for releases (e.g. acme/web-app). Each new release triggers a metric snapshot at T+0, T+24h, T+7d. Leave blank to disable release tracking.

SECOND PostHog API key — narrowly scoped to Cohort write ONLY. Used ONLY to maintain the two cohorts 'PostHog-agent: Power Users' and 'PostHog-agent: Dying Users'. Leave blank to disable auto-cohort sync. NEVER reuse the read-only key here.
